answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 49350 Country: India Title: While offering Eid namaz behind imam, if musalli says Allah Akbar and goes into ruku after imam says Allah Akbar in second rakah (after zaid takbir), is namaz fasid? Question: While offering Eid namaz behind imam, if musalli says Allah Akbar and goes into ruku after imam says Allah Akbar in second rakah (after zaid takbir), is namaz fasid? In daily namaz, if musalli say takbir (except takbir tahrima) behind imam, will his namaz become fasid? Answer ID: 49350 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1976/H-548/TH=01/1434) Salah shall not be invalid in both the cases, rather it shall be correct without even being makrooh. And the muqtadi should say takbeer in such case in low voice, and it is sunnah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
